groups.rationale: Follow-up formatting, review note and tests after the chapter update in this change; every selection now lists the guest_lifecycle runtime package the bootstrap imports; 17-reference and 22-topology record the launchable guest-lifecycle Antithesis profile beside the other optional profiles: guest-vmm QEMU TCG plus a STUB-storage container Lilly (fixed synthetic pool, no ZFS), operator image registration, and a bootstrap gate on guest identity and catalog capacity; no native or hosted evidence is claimed.
Marshall source is unchanged by this change; the 22-topology addition describes only the Antithesis guest-lifecycle harness placement and its operator-only socket and catalog boundaries.
Protocol source is unchanged by this change; 17-reference and 22-topology add only the Antithesis guest-lifecycle harness profile and its stub-storage boundary.

Follow-up formatting, review note and tests after the chapter update in this change; Lilly runtime gains a harness-only compile branch: the ANTITHESIS_GUEST container release uses a labelled STUB-storage collector and guest-vmm health gate; 17-reference and 22-topology record that it is not native ZFS, KVM or capacity evidence. Production and integrated-host branches are unchanged.
Service source is unchanged by this change; the 22-topology addition describes only the Antithesis guest-lifecycle harness placement.

Fleet and nix/ sources are unchanged by this change; the 22-topology addition concerns only the isolated Antithesis guest-lifecycle Compose profile, whose lilly-guest context now carries the TCG guest image.

Follow-up formatting, review note and tests after the chapter update in this change; 17-reference records the guest-lifecycle selection beside recorder-host, its stub-storage limits and readiness gate; antithesis CONTRACTS add the stub-substrate labelling obligation. Verification scope widens to one selectable emulated profile with no recorded run.
